landing.heroTitle: Master Russian from the MADI Campus to the Heart of Moscow
landing.howStep1Title: 01. Tune Up in the Alphabet Garage
landing.howStep1Body: Learn all 33 Cyrillic letters across 6 structured stops—starting with familiar look-alikes before tackling unique Russian sounds.
landing.howStep2Body: Match spoken sounds, build stressed Russian words on our custom Cyrillic keyboard, and connect visuals to real campus vocabulary.
landing.howStep3Title: 03. Earn Fuel & Keep Your Odometer Rolling
landing.howStep3Body: Every correct answer adds +10 Fuel. Maintain your daily kilometer streak with one automatic Spare Tire freeze per week.
landing.roadPreviewSubtitle: Follow the route from Leningradsky Prospekt (MADI Main Building) to Red Square and beyond.
landing.motivationalSub: Stay motivated: we make learning Russian grammar a daily habit
landing.aiLearningSub: A learning experience designed specifically for you by combining the best of what artificial intelligence offers
landing.featAudioBody: Every Russian word displays explicit stress accents (ударе́ние) with instant Web Speech synthesis and studio audio support.
landing.featWritingBody: Compare printed and cursive Russian forms side-by-side and type on an ergonomic Cyrillic layout with Ё, Ъ, and Ы.
landing.featSpeakingBody: Clear pronunciation comparisons tailored to your chosen UI language (English, Arabic, French, or Russian).
landing.featDictionaryBody: Missed exercises are automatically logged to your Garage pit-stop list so you never stall on tricky letters.
landing.madiBannerTitle: Made by MADI for Learners Everywhere
landing.madiBannerBody: Designed for international engineering, road construction, and automotive students preparing for life and lectures in Moscow.
landing.footerCopy: madingo — Open Russian Learning Platform for MADI Students.
